title: The Loose Drop
author: Quentin Blackwood
blurb: Beatrix Sterling, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
